verdict.rationale: Poke is an AI assistant operated through conversation in messaging apps. Its docs say it performs actions across connected apps "through natural conversation", manages reminders "naturally", and builds charts from plain descriptions. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of natural-language operation quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Once connected, Poke can access information and perform actions across apps and services through natural conversation.
Poke is your AI assistant that lives in Apple Messages, Telegram, WhatsApp, and RCS.
Reminders - Set and manage reminders naturally
Describe what you want to see, or share images of existing data (like spreadsheets) for Poke to extract and visualize.
